scope: First-mapping approval/send-back page, 96 systems and 576 files; source/layout endpoints mocked in isolated Electron homes. Warm gesture measurements, not cold opening, memory acceptance or daemon capacity.
method: Production Electron, 1400x900, Windows reference laptop i7-13700H. 96 pointer positions with 8 ms requested spacing and reversals, then return to start. WASD holds d/a/d/a for 200 ms each; paths/durations differ so keyboard/mouse timings are diagnostic comparisons. rAF intervals, not direct paint/input latency. Shared development laptop; retained slow and rejected controls. JSON omits source contents, user/project identifiers and filesystem paths. Baseline and early controls finish after the 96-position sweep; final runs also return the pointer to the start and check gesture-state restoration.
